violations.reason: The user stated the cancellation reason was a change of plans. Reservation details showed 0HUIH5 was an economy round trip created 2024-05-01, more than 24 hours before the policy current time of 2024-05-15, with insurance 'yes' but no airline cancellation indicated. A change of plans is not a health or weather reason covered by insurance, so no cancellation condition was satisfied. The agent nevertheless said it could be cancelled and called cancel_reservation without ensuring the cancellation rules applied.
